The '''Wyvern Dragon Helmet Skin''' is a {{Legendary}} [[Helmet Skin]] that can be purchased from the Hypixel Store.

== Obtaining ==
{{Cosmetic Miscellaneous Source|The '''Wyvern Dragon Helmet Skin''' can be purchased from the Hypixel Store as part of the 2026 Summer Legacy Bundle.|Hypixel Store 2026 Summer Legacy Bundle}}
